message.content:
This editorial illustration features a large man in a yellow shirt and dark pants. He holds a massive, curved red and blue pipe labeled "B30" in yellow. From the pipe's metallic nozzle, he sprays paper currency like water into the air. Three smaller men in business attire stand below, catching the falling money in large blue barrels and a bucket. One man holds a barrel on the ground, another holds a bucket over his head, and the third holds a barrel tilted toward the spray. The background shows a pale blue sky with wispy clouds over a hilly, tan landscape.

The text at the top includes "TEMPO," "Denda Berpendapat di Media Sosial H.22," and "Cuci Uang Haram lewat Kripto H.78." A barcode and "11-17 APRIL 2022 RP 50.000" are in the upper right. The main title at the bottom reads "INVESTIGASI Kroni Dana Sawit." Below it, smaller text states, "Subsidi dana sawit dinikmati pengusaha biodiesel. Petani terlilit utang, tutupan hutan hilang. H.34."
